messages:
Ava Nguyen: Quick sync — we have ~30 glossary terms left that conflict with SDK param names (camelCase vs snake_case). I'd like to propose a migration note that maps the doc canonical term -> SDK param. @Marco can you confirm if renaming params is on the roadmap?
Marco Diaz: Not planning breaking renames in the next sprint. We can add aliases for compatibility and deprecate over time.
Priya Shah: +1 for aliases. For docs we should show both forms in examples: canonical term (SDK param). That helps discoverability for users skimming the API quickstart.
Lena Brooks: Also propose a tiny style rule: first mention uses canonical term, then show SDK param in parentheses, e.g., "temperature (temperature)" or "generation_length (generationLength)" — keep it compact. :thumbsup:
Ava Nguyen: Good. Can we standardize the exact microcopy for the parentheses? I suggest: "<canonical> (SDK: <paramName>)" — short and explicit.
Marco Diaz: Works for me. Backend will accept both `generation_length` and `generationLength` as query params for now. I'll open an internal RFC for the deprecation timeline.
DocBot: PR #3521 opened by @marco: add SDK aliases + accept both cases (CI: tests pass) :white_check_mark:
Priya Shah: Nice. For the migration guide section, we should include a small code snippet showing both idioms and how to log deprecated usage. Example: 
```python
# preferred (docs canonical)
client.generate(model="redwood-beta", generation_length=128)

# compatible (SDK camelCase)
client.generate(model="redwood-beta", generationLength=128)
```
Lena Brooks: Also add a short note under "Voice & tone" about naming: prefer noun-first phrasing ("response length") not adjective-first ("long response"). Keep microcopy active: "Set response length" not "Response length can be set". :eyes:
Ava Nguyen: I'll draft the glossary change PR with: 1) canonical -> SDK mapping table, 2) migration snippet from Priya, 3) a deprecation banner template. Assigning items: drafting PR (Ava), RFC + timeline (Marco), examples + tests (Priya), voice blurb (Lena).
Marco Diaz: I'll target the RFC for end of next week. Will link it in the PR.
Priya Shah: I'll add the examples and a quick unit test that asserts both param names yield the same payload.
DocBot: reminder: docs CI will run on PR creation. Use `docs/format` label to skip formatting if you need to keep snippet spacing.
Ava Nguyen: Thanks all. I'll post the PR link here when ready. If anyone spots weird phrasing in the canonical names, flag in the PR comments — want final sign-off from product before publishing. :thumbsup:
